description: detaxizer, with --generate-downstream-samplesheets, writes downstream_samplesheets/mag-pe.csv for its filtered paired-end reads, in the column layout of mag 3.x; every sample goes into co-assembly group 0 and gets the read platforms mag 5 requires (short reads ILLUMINA, long reads OXFORD_NANOPORE, as detaxizer labels them for taxprofiler).
